content: Plate Recognizer (platerecognizer.com) is a commercial ANPR/ALPR API. It accepts an image (multipart upload or URL) and returns JSON with detected plates, confidence scores, and region. Offers a Python SDK and on-premise/stream options. Pricing is per-request tiers with a free tier. Accuracy is high for standard plates but degrades on angled/blurred/low-light images. For this project it is a viable external OCR service; the request/response is a simple POST image -> JSON plates.
